reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in his DM to confirm that his standing Thistle rollout call with the Marrow Fieldworks team is now Fridays at 8:30. As he asked, I didn't change his calendar.

I didn't save a separate note to the brain. gbrain already records his DMs and shows them only to him. The save tool's description didn't say who could read a new note, so a manual save might have shared his message with other people.
